title: Pinecone API key (pcsk_): one-property twin (length)
summary: 4 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 4-character label vs the tool-corroborated 5-6 (trufflehog's pinecone test rejects a 4-character label), length: 62-character secret segment vs the tool-corroborated 63, and length: 64-character secret segment vs the tool-corroborated 63 (pleno-dlp's open pcsk_[A-Za-z0-9_]{40,} still accepts it; recorded peer difference), and 1 more. Twin of "Pinecone API key (pcsk_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of pinecone-api-key-api-key-header: length: 62-character secret segment vs the tool-corroborated 63. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
